item.title: Diddy in Prison: The Surprising Truth About His Life Behind Bars
item.description:
Picture one of the most powerful men in music history checking out movies for fellow inmates from a prison chapel library. That is the reality for Diddy in 2026.

The Bad Boy Records founder, once a fixture at the world’s most exclusive parties, now walks a federal prison yard in a gray sweatsuit. His hair and beard have gone fully gray. And the man who built an empire is counting down months, not planning galas.

item.title: Kathie Lee Gifford's Surprising Year of Pain and Resilience
item.description:
Kathie Lee Gifford says she feels “like Mr. Potato Head” — and at 72, the beloved TV legend has earned the right to joke about it.

In a candid new PEOPLE cover story, the former Today co-host pulled back the curtain on what may be the hardest year of her life: a cascade of surgeries, fractures, and chronic pain so severe she admits she “wanted to die.” Yet she greeted the interview the way she’s greeted five decades in the spotlight — cracking jokes and refusing to quit.

item.title: Colman Domingo's Unstoppable 2026: Why He's Everywhere Right Now
item.description:
Colman Domingo’s Unstoppable 2026: Why He’s Everywhere Right Now

What do an HBO season finale, a Netflix comedy abroad, an Ivy-adjacent commencement stage, and a Gus Van Sant set have in common? Colman Domingo — and he’s pulling it all off in the span of a single month.

Quick Summary: Colman Domingo is having a defining 2026. He anchored the explosive Euphoria Season 3 finale, returned in The Four Seasons Season 2 alongside Tina Fey and Will Forte, received an honorary degree from Temple University, and is shooting with director Gus Van Sant on Dead Man’s Wire. Two Academy Award nominations, an Emmy, and a Time 100 nod — and he’s still climbing.
